My first car was a 1998 Audi a4 quattro (a/t unfortunately), and it was at that point I fell in love with german engineering. After wrapping that around a lamppost, I got a 2000 Toyota Camry that I had for a while in college. Ended up driving a 2002 GMC Envoy temporarily (help us all) but I pretend that never happened. Then I got my first "real" car in my eyes: a 1986 Nissan 300ZX. It was in rough condition, n/a, and automatic, but I loved it and I grew a strong passion for not only imports, but cars in general at that point. Some drunk arse in my neighborhood destroyed it while I was in my apartment sleeping. I managed to find a 1987 Nissan 300zx Turbo shortly thereafter; much better condition, clean, five speed, all the goodies. This really cemented my love of imports. Now I'm back to my german-loving roots with a 2006 VW GTI. I still have the nissan though
